stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $189M, push August inflows near $1B
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in $189 million in new money. August net inflows are now close to $1 billion. The inflows point to steady institutional demand for bitcoin exposure through regulated funds.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows show how much institutional money enters bitcoin without direct purchases.
whatToWatch: Whether August inflows pass $1 billion
Next daily ETF flow reports
questions: Which issuers drove the inflows?
Is the money from new investors or existing ones?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $189M as August net inflows approach $1B

stories.title: New method cuts Ethereum proving from 12 GPUs to 4
stories.summary: A new technical approach lowers the GPU count needed for Ethereum zero-knowledge proving. It cuts the requirement from twelve GPUs to four. Lower hardware needs could cut the cost of running proof systems for Ethereum's scaling layers.
stories.whyItMatters: Cheaper proving lowers the barrier to running Ethereum scaling infrastructure, which affects who can compete to run it.
whatToWatch: Adoption by rollup teams
Independent tests of the claimed efficiency gain
questions: Which team built this method?
Has it run in production yet?

sources.title: Ethereum’s 12-GPU proving problem just got a 4-GPU answer

stories.title: FalconX and Interstice link Canton to Ethereum, Solana, and Robinhood Chain
stories.summary: FalconX and Interstice built new links between the Canton network and Ethereum, Solana, and Robinhood Chain. The links let assets and data move across these separate blockchains. The project is part of a wider push to connect institutional and retail-facing chains.
stories.whyItMatters: Links between chains can widen access to tokenized assets and cut fragmentation between institutional and consumer platforms.
whatToWatch: Which assets move across the new links first
Whether more chains join the network
questions: What use cases will use this link first?

sources.title: FalconX, Interstice Connect Canton to Ethereum, Solana and Robinhood Chain

stories.title: Maya Protocol exploit drains assets; pool value falls $11M
stories.summary: An exploit hit Maya Protocol and drained bitcoin and other assets from its pools. The protocol's pool value fell by $11 million. The exact method of the attack and any recovery plan are not yet known.
stories.whyItMatters: DeFi exploits like this are a recurring risk for protocols that hold user funds, and they hurt trust in cross-chain and liquidity protocols.
whatToWatch: An official statement from Maya Protocol
Whether any funds are recovered
questions: What vulnerability did the attacker use?
Will affected users get reimbursed?

sources.title: Maya Protocol exploit drains bitcoin and other assets as pool value drops $11 million

stories.title: Bitcoin holds $64,000; solana leads gains as Korean chip stocks fall 7%
stories.summary: Bitcoin stayed above $64,000 while solana posted the largest gains among major tokens. The moves came as South Korean semiconductor stocks fell 7%. Crypto markets held up better than that part of the equity market.
stories.whyItMatters: This shows how crypto prices react to stress in equity markets, which matters for anyone watching cross-market correlation.
whatToWatch: Whether bitcoin holds the $64,000 level
Further moves in Asian equity markets
questions: What caused the chip stock slide?
Will crypto stay correlated with equities?

sources.title: Bitcoin holds $64,000 and solana leads gains amid 7% Korean chip stock slide

stories.title: Bitcoin stays above $64,000 as oil rises and Kospi drops 6%
stories.summary: Bitcoin held above $64,000 in a rolling market update. Oil prices rose in the same period, and South Korea's Kospi index fell 6%. No single cause was given for the combined moves.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin's steadiness during a sharp equity and oil move tests whether it acts as a hedge or tracks risk assets.
whatToWatch: Further Kospi and oil price moves
Whether bitcoin keeps the $64,000 level
questions: What triggered the Kospi drop?
Will crypto decouple from the equity slide?

sources.title: Live updates: Bitcoin remains above $64,000 as oil rises and the Kospi tumbles 6%

stories.title: Solana treasury firm may sell SOL after DeFi loan locks up its holdings
stories.summary: A corporate Solana treasury company may sell SOL. A DeFi loan has tied up more than half of its treasury. It is not yet clear if a sale will happen.
stories.whyItMatters: Corporate treasuries that use DeFi leverage can face liquidity squeezes that force asset sales, a risk for anyone tracking treasury-company stocks.
whatToWatch: Whether the company confirms a SOL sale
The status of the DeFi loan
questions: Which company is this?
What led the loan to tie up so much of the treasury?

sources.title: This Solana treasury company may sell SOL as a DeFi loan ties up more than half its treasury

stories.title: FASB proposes rules for treating stablecoins as cash equivalents
stories.summary: The US Financial Accounting Standards Board proposed conditions for classifying stablecoins as cash equivalents. The proposal would set accounting rules for how companies report stablecoin holdings. It follows growing corporate use of stablecoins for payments and treasury work.
stories.whyItMatters: Clear accounting rules make it easier for companies to hold and use stablecoins, which could speed up corporate adoption.
whatToWatch: The public comment period on the proposal
The timeline for a final rule
questions: Which conditions must a stablecoin meet?
Which stablecoins would qualify?

sources.title: US accounting board FASB proposes conditions for stablecoins as cash equivalents

stories.title: Neuberger Berman and Securitize launch multi-chain tokenized bond fund
stories.summary: Neuberger Berman partnered with Securitize to launch a tokenized fixed-income fund. The fund runs across multiple blockchains. It adds to a growing list of asset managers that put traditional products on blockchain rails.
stories.whyItMatters: Tokenized funds from established asset managers show deepening institutional use of blockchain-based financial products.
whatToWatch: The fund's launch date and initial size
Which chains it supports at launch
questions: Which blockchains will the fund use?
What is the minimum investment?

stories.title: SEC proposes its first major crypto rule in surprise move
stories.summary: The US Securities and Exchange Commission proposed its first major crypto-specific rule. The announcement came as a surprise to the market. The SEC has mostly used enforcement actions in the past, not formal rules.
stories.whyItMatters: A formal rule, instead of enforcement action, could give the crypto industry clearer and more lasting guardrails.
whatToWatch: The full text and scope of the proposed rule
The public comment period
Industry reaction
questions: What does the rule cover?
Why did the SEC act now, and why the surprise?

sources.title: U.S. SEC proposes first major crypto rule in surprise announcement

stories.title: Wyoming moves its state stablecoin, joins $15B exodus from LayerZero
stories.summary: Wyoming moved its state-issued stablecoin away from LayerZero. The move is part of a larger $15 billion shift away from the network. Other projects have reportedly made similar exits.
stories.whyItMatters: A state-backed stablecoin's choice to leave LayerZero signals confidence concerns that matter to anyone who relies on its cross-chain messaging.
whatToWatch: Which infrastructure Wyoming moves to
Whether more projects leave LayerZero
questions: What prompted the move away from LayerZero?
How large is the full exodus, in projects and value?

stories.title: Cash App adds more crypto assets beyond bitcoin and USDC via MoonPay
stories.summary: Cash App expanded its crypto support beyond bitcoin and USDC. The expansion runs through a partnership with MoonPay. It adds to the range of tokens users can access in the app.
stories.whyItMatters: Wider crypto access on a mainstream payment app expands retail exposure to digital assets beyond the largest tokens.
whatToWatch: Which new assets Cash App adds
User adoption of the expanded support
questions: Which cryptocurrencies are being added?
Does MoonPay add extra fees?
